chemo=get_rows('supp.xlsx','Chemo ')
for col,drug in [(2,'gem'),(3,'pac'),(4,'sn38'),(5,'5fu'),(6,'oxa')]:
    vals=sorted(float(r[col-1]) for r in chemo[2:] if isinstance(r[col-1],(int,float)))
    print(drug,len(vals),'33 cutoff index22',vals[21],vals[22], '34 high cutoff', vals[-23], vals[-22])
    for id in ['hF31','hF2','hM1A','hF57','hF44','hF23','hF50','hF3','hF28']:
        row=next(r for r in chemo if r[0]==id)
        v=row[col-1]
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            rank=sum(x<=v for x in vals)
            print(id,v,'rank',rank, 'S' if rank<=22 else 'R' if rank>=44 else 'I')
    print()
